# glinet_wireless_interface_settings (Resource)

Manage SSID, disabled, hidden, and client-isolation settings on an existing named OpenWrt wifi-iface AP section. This resource never creates or deletes a Wi-Fi interface. Destroy releases Terraform management and leaves router settings unchanged. Changes reload Wi-Fi and can interrupt connections. Use a wired management connection. Passwords, encryption, radios, and network membership are outside this resource's scope.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "glinet_wireless_interface_settings" "guest_2g" {
  section  = "guest2g"
  ssid     = "example-guest"
  disabled = false
  hidden   = false
  isolate  = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `disabled` (Boolean) Whether the Wi-Fi interface is disabled.
- `hidden` (Boolean) Whether the SSID is hidden from ordinary Wi-Fi network lists.
- `isolate` (Boolean) Whether wireless clients on this interface are isolated from one another. This does not replace firewall isolation between networks.
- `section` (String) Existing named UCI section in wireless, such as `wifi2g`. Anonymous index selectors are not supported. Import using this section name.
- `ssid` (String) Wi-Fi network name, 1–32 UTF-8 bytes without control characters.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import glinet_wireless_interface_settings.guest_2g guest2g
```
